name: Dragon C2
about: Dragon C2 (2012-027A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon), launched 2012 May 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 May 24), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
